# Monti

> Monti is an independent designer creating cover art, 3D illustration and
> Spotify Canvas loops for musicians. Work is delivered ready for streaming,
> social media and print, with up to 3 revision rounds included on every project.

## About

Monti (Monti Moltisanti) designs visual identity for music releases — the cover
people see before they hear the song. Clients work directly with the designer:
no agency, no middleman. Files arrive at the correct sizes and formats for
Spotify, Apple Music, social platforms and print.

## Services and pricing (EUR)

- Cover Art Design — from €150. Single, EP or album artwork.
- 3D Illustration — from €250. Full 3D scenes built and lit from scratch.
- Animation / Spotify Canvas Visualizer — from €300. Loops (3–8s) in 1080p or 4K.
- Full Album Visual Identity — custom quote. Cover, motion and supporting assets.

Every project includes up to 3 revision rounds.

## Process

1. Send the brief — the song, references and deadline.
2. We shape it — the designer iterates with you across up to 3 revision rounds.
3. You release — high-res masters plus exports sized for every platform.
